snippet.title: Son Of Thanjai - Release Window Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
The Chola empire is dying from the inside. As the prince, cast out onto the streets, you must reclaim what is yours and discover what it means to be king. "Can a kingdom be saved by its worst son?" Son of Thanjai comes to Xbox Series X/S, PC, Cloud, and Game Pass in Spring 2027.

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
